newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Military helicopters land in Tirana.
newsitem.headline: Military helicopters land in Tirana.

text.p: Several military helicopters flew over centre of the Albanian capital Tirana and landed in the centre of the city, apparently to collect nationals of Western countries fleeing unrest in the Balkan country.
Witnesses saw the helicopters land in a stadium in the city centre, not far from both government buildings and the U.S. embassy.

The helicopters were from the Italian military and a small number of Italian troops deployed around the stadium while several dozen people were picked up. Italian officials on the spot refused to comment.
Sporadic shooting rang out in Tirana on Friday morning but it had subsided considerably from the previous day. Tanks were deployed for a time during the night near key government buildings.

Britain's Foreign Office said it had evacuated 131 people successfully from Albania on Friday morning and they were now on an Italian naval vessel on their way to the Italian Adriatic port of Brindisi.
